gloss: ruins complex; group of archaeological sites

definitions.gloss: ruins complex; cluster of archaeological sites
definitions.explanation: A group or cluster of related archaeological remains or historical ruins in the same area. Often used in the names of UNESCO World Heritage Sites or nationally designated cultural properties.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{縄文時代|じょうもんじだい}→縄文時代：18895_joumonjidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遺跡群|いせきぐん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This area has a complex of Jomon-period ruins.

examples.japanese: ⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧・{北東北|きたとうほく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{縄文遺跡群|じょうもんいせきぐん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{世界遺産|せかいいさん}→世界遺産：04897_sekaiisan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{登録|とうろく}→登録：05703_touroku⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The Jomon ruins complex of Hokkaido and northern Tohoku was registered as a World Heritage Site.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古代|こだい}→古代：05324_kodai⟧ローマ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遺跡群|いせきぐん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見学|けんがく}→見学：00214_kengaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦イタリア→イタリア：19423_itaria⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れた→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧。
examples.english: I visited Italy to tour the ruins complex of ancient Rome.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{遺跡|いせき}→遺跡：09527_iseki⟧ (ruins; archaeological site) + ⟦{群|ぐん}→群：02790_gun⟧ (group; cluster). The suffix ⟦{群|ぐん}→群：02790_gun⟧ indicates a collection or cluster of the same type of thing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {縄文遺跡群|じょうもんいせきぐん}: Jomon ruins complex
- {古代遺跡群|こだいいせきぐん}: ancient ruins complex
- {世界遺産遺跡群|せかいいさんいせきぐん}: World Heritage ruins complex

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{遺跡|いせき}→遺跡：09527_iseki⟧: ruins; archaeological site — a single site or remains
- ⟦{史跡|しせき}→史跡：11952_shiseki⟧: historic site — a site of historical significance (often a designated cultural property)
